summary: Round-5 normal research round. Read question, board_recent, both live summaries, both student round-4 HANDOFFs, the round-4 verifier VERIFICATION.md + board post_017, and pi/verified.yaml; inspected jobs/ (empty, only jobs/collected). HEADLINE: the round-4 verifier (Finding 2) refuted a PI-authored standing rule that I introduced by over-generalizing pi_vchk_002 -- 'the coupling fan is magnitude ties, NOT Q_T walls.' That blanket rule is FALSE: R_spline and A_6 itself genuinely jump across the 3-leg factorization walls Q_{m;pq}=omega_p^2+omega_q^2-omega_m^2=k_{m,p,q}=0, at order EXACTLY 3, as an S3xS3 orbit. I ran a targeted, fully independent PI double-check (pi_vchk_003) confirming this on a fresh md5-matched BG via BG*C (no P_pole dependence), then corrected the shared research state. The spline now lives on the JOINT fan {q_mp=0} U {Q_{m;pq}=0}: 9 two-leg order-1 walls (brick H_mp, deg 6, done) + 9 three-leg order-3 walls (brick G_{m;pq}, deg 2 predicted, NOT yet extracted). I also supplied a kinematic wall-set completeness enumeration (k_S=-k_{S^c}; same-sector sums never vanish -> exactly 18 hyperplanes) as a candidate to confirm. Both students' round-4 obstructions (s1 rank 17<18, s2 1/8-cell) are the predicted symptom of the missing Q-orbit. G1 persists (blocking), re-scoped to the joint fan. Directed both students complementarily: student-2 bottom-up extraction+factoring of the order-3 Q-brick; student-1 wall-set completeness + joint-fan assembly.

pi_double_check.reason: The round-4 verifier (Finding 2, HEADLINE) refuted a PI-authored standing rule I introduced by over-generalizing pi_vchk_002. Because the reversal reshapes the entire remaining deliverable and overturns my own prior conclusion, I independently confirmed the load-bearing physical sub-claim (A_6 itself jumps across the 3-leg subset-momentum wall Q_{1;46}=k_{1,4,6}=0) before rewriting the shared state.
pi_double_check.method: Fresh md5-matched bg (bots/pi/code, md5=41715c4af3ee5a61b1c4bfce40426ac8). On-shell polynomial line w(t)=(8,2,-3,-5,4,-6)+t(-2,1,0,2,-1,0), re-derived on-shell. Exact rational certification that the full magnitude sort order (1,2,4,3,5,0) and all nine q_mp signs are constant on 15 left + 3 right nodes and only Q_{1;46} crosses zero (t0=1/4). Interpolated N(t)=(A_6/i)*C exactly (Lagrange, fractions) on 12 left nodes; tested 3 left holdouts + 3 right nodes. Script bots/pi/code/pi_vchk_003_Qwall_jump.py; uses ONLY fresh BG + smooth C, no P_pole and no student/verifier evaluator.
pi_double_check.outcome: PASS/CONFIRMED. Left cell: 3/3 holdouts zero residual (A_6*C polynomial). Right cell (same magnitude cell): all 3 fail with large nonzero residuals. So A_6 jumps across Q_{1;46}=0 with no magnitude tie involved. Confirms verifier F15/V3; retires the PI 'no Q_T walls' rule. Recorded as pi_vchk_003 in bots/pi/verified.yaml. Does NOT clear G1.
